in_sanskrit.name: बुध्ददेव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The god who has bestowed Buddhi (wisdom)

in_hindi.name: बुध्ददेव
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (God) का हिसाब से बुधि (विज्ञान, प्राकृतिक ज्ञान) दिया गया है (The god who has bestowed Buddhi (wisdom))

in_marathi.name: Buddhadev
in_marathi.long_meaning: Buddhadev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Buddhadev is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Buddha’ (enlightened one) and ‘dev’ (god). This name is a tribute to those who have attained enlightenment and embodies the divine presence of a Buddha.
